requirementChecks.criteria: Read the original file properties: Format: presentation document; at least eight actual pages. Stage: final.

Show seven distinct records corresponding to T01, T02, B01, B02, F01, F02 and J01, with each matching footwear pair represented as one record. T01, B01, F01, F02 and J01 are available; T02 is in laundry and B02 is loaned. Include category browsing and a recognisable manual garment-entry action. The main totals must be seven items and five available. Layout and navigation may vary; duplicate records, incorrect statuses, automatic-only entry or missing browsing controls fail.

Identify Cream knit sweater as the cream top with long sleeves, crew neck and ribbed neck, cuffs and hem. Retain the original note, 'Recorded laundry window ends Monday at 18:00.', and show its laundry window from 13 September 2026 at 20:00 to 14 September 2026 at 18:00, UTC+08:00. Provide a manual-edit action. Date formatting and field arrangement may vary if the same record is unambiguous; altered fields, an omitted original note or a shortened laundry record fail.

Both views retain exactly T01, B01, F01 and J01. The editor visibly represents unsaved D03 for Coffee catch-up initially at 09:30–10:30, with the manually added jacket suggestion applied. Beside that suggestion, show Planning outlook, 18°C and light rain for 14 September. Saving an outfit and committing an occasion must remain distinct actions named Save outfit and Confirm plan wherever those actions are offered. The detail identifies saved Rain walk and confirmed Coffee catch-up on 14 September 2026 at 11:00–12:00. Internal IDs may be discreet or omitted; human-readable identity, membership and state must be clear. Missing members, treating the applied jacket as merely proposed, conflating save with confirmation or presenting the saved detail as an unsaved draft fail.

The calendar shows Studio review with Navy weekday on 14 September 2026, 09:00–10:00; Coffee catch-up with Rain walk that day, 11:00–12:00; and Bookshop afternoon with Easy weekend on 16 September, 14:00–15:00. Rain walk detail agrees with the Coffee catch-up record. Interpret all times as UTC+08:00; a shared timezone context is sufficient. Calendar layout and date formatting may vary, but changed existing events, conflicting appointment details or retaining Coffee catch-up at its initial time fail.

Provide six clearly labelled groups. Availability includes Available, In laundry and Loaned badges with labelled symbols and distinguishable suggested, awaiting-confirmation and applied outer-layer indicators; the suggestion remains dismissible. Search shows query purple, zero matches and query clearing without deleting the wardrobe. Reservation preserves editable D03 with T01, B01, F01 and J01 at 09:30–10:30, identifies only Navy Oxford shirt and Charcoal straight trousers as reserved by Studio review at 09:00–10:00, and includes disabled Confirm plan and an error time field. Repeat advice connects the identical Navy weekday set T01, B01 and F02 used on 14 September to Portfolio coffee on 15 September, 18:00–19:00, and offers acknowledgement and continuation rather than a hard block. Discard contrasts the unsaved T01 note 'Steam collar before use.' with original 'Hang after wearing.' and offers continued editing or discarding to restore the original. Success names saved Rain walk, confirmed Coffee catch-up and 11:00–12:00, with default and pressed Confirm plan samples. Group arrangement and discreet ID display may vary; missing groups, incorrect records, indistinguishable required control states or missing recovery actions fail.

Each screen uses a platform-neutral portrait phone interface and keeps meaningful text and interactive controls inside the safe region indicated by the supplied phone drawing: 62 logical points clear at the top and 34 at the bottom. Judge placement proportionally when exports are scaled; backgrounds may extend into the reserved regions. Essential content or controls intruding into those regions fail.

Rendered body text must achieve at least 4.5:1 foreground/background contrast, and large text and meaningful icons at least 3:1. Availability and feedback must pair colour with readable labels and meaningful symbols. Apply the thresholds to the actual visible background, including component samples. Different palettes are allowed; insufficient contrast, colour-only status distinctions or symbols lacking understandable labels fail.

Where garments are pictured, use the corresponding supplied identity image while preserving its colour, construction, parts, orientation and existing surface details. Uniform resizing, framing that retains identifying construction and background removal are allowed. Redrawing, recolouring, distortion, mirroring that changes the supplied orientation, destructive cropping or substituting different garments fail. This rule does not require garment pictures in feedback examples that communicate their records through text.

The three boards respectively establish garment-led, outfit-led and occasion-led navigation, each tracing wardrobe access through outfit editing to a calendar plan and proposing a recognisably distinct visual direction. Labelled garment placeholders or supplied images are acceptable at this stage. Three cosmetic variants of the same navigation, missing stages or an unidentifiable alternative fail.

The two-page document records one explicit selection from the three compared alternatives and presents that decision as following their comparison. State the chosen landing-page name, applicable page names, primary-action colour code and Available / In laundry / Loaned vocabulary. Include a page × entry × data table covering the delivered phone views and, in tier 24, tablet views. Include a component × state × value table with default and pressed Confirm plan, disabled Confirm plan and error time-field values, explicit colours and contrast ratios meeting 4.5:1 for body text and 3:1 for large text and meaningful icons. Specify status labels and symbols plus dismissible suggested, awaiting-confirmation and applied outer-layer states. Table styling and navigation choice are open; an unstated selection, missing applicable views, absent state values or noncompliant declared contrast fails.

Retain unsaved, editable Rain walk D03 with T01, B01, F01 and J01 for Coffee catch-up on 14 September at 09:30–10:30. Identify only Navy Oxford shirt and Charcoal straight trousers as reserved by Studio review, 09:00–10:00; sneakers and jacket must not be flagged for that reservation. Disable Confirm plan, show the time error and provide a garment-editing route or the permitted 11:00–12:00 alternative. Different error layouts are allowed; lost draft members, an enabled confirmation action, incorrect affected garments or silently changed existing events fail.

Show evidence that the user explicitly selected 11:00–12:00 after the initial conflicting time, followed by saved Rain walk O03 and confirmed Coffee catch-up E02 on 14 September. Preserve T01, B01, F01 and J01 and agree with the calendar and saved detail. A selected-time recap or visible transition annotation may establish the choice. Where saving and committing actions are represented, name them Save outfit and Confirm plan respectively. A success message with no evidence of explicit time choice, automatic rescheduling, changed membership or inconsistent final records fails.

Keep meaningful text and controls within the phone drawing's safe region, with 62 logical points reserved above and 34 below, in a platform-neutral portrait interface. Evaluate scaled exports proportionally. Decorative backgrounds may extend beyond the safe region; obstructed or intruding essential content fails.

Provide at least eight pages. Page one repeats the specification's selected direction, landing-page name and primary-action colour code. The presentation agrees on Rain walk and Coffee catch-up on 14 September at 11:00–12:00, retains Studio review with Navy weekday that day at 09:00–10:00 and Bookshop afternoon with Easy weekend on 16 September at 14:00–15:00, and preserves any repeated laundry and loan intervals. Repeat the default, pressed, disabled and error component examples and all three availability labels. Readable reuse may carry these facts; contradicting the source files, missing opening-page facts or insufficient pages fails.

Visibly reuse identifiable material from every listed source, including the selected direction and interaction specification. Scaling, readable excerpts and presentation annotations are allowed. Merely naming a source, substituting unrelated mockups or omitting any listed source fails.

Review the complete 12-second video against the delivered screens. It must show the unsaved four-member D03 editor, the reservation conflict, the user's explicit choice of 11:00–12:00, saved Rain walk and confirmed Coffee catch-up, and the resulting calendar. Save outfit and Confirm plan serve their distinct named actions; memberships and existing events persist. Screen appearances retain phone safe areas. Transitions and camera framing may vary if the flow remains readable; omitted stages, automatic time changes, contradictory records, unsafe cropping or a different duration fail.
